name: CERT-In Directions
description: CERT-In directions of 28 April 2022 under s.70B(6) IT Act (paraphrased obligations).

controls.title: Clock synchronization to NPL/NIC
controls.description: ICT system clocks are synchronized to the NTP servers of NPL or NIC.

checks.rationale: Configuration evidence of NPL/NIC NTP sync is the direct artifact.

controls.title: 6-hour incident reporting
controls.description: Cyber incidents are reported to CERT-In within 6 hours of noticing or being brought to notice.

checks.rationale: The documented procedure must cover the 6-hour CERT-In window.
Reporting executes through the IR program.

controls.title: Designation of a point of contact for CERT-In
180-day log retention
controls.description: Logs of all ICT systems are maintained securely for a rolling period of 180 days within India.
controls.evidence_guidance: Log retention configuration and operative logging.

checks.rationale: Retention configuration evidence covers the 180-day mandate.
Operative logging is a precondition for retention.

controls.title: Vulnerability and incident detection capability
controls.description: Organizations maintain the capability to detect security incidents and vulnerabilities in their infrastructure.

checks.rationale: Frequent scans evidence detection capability operating.

controls.title: KYC and transaction records for virtual asset providers (5 years)
